louisella.independent_visual_review: Reopened genuine original concept and personally inspected the three actual ROM pixels above. On all eight final 512px views and sheet, a very sharply tapering pointed posterior remains, contradicting frozen rounded/blunt posterior; paired dorsal papilla rows exist in geometry but read weakly/near a single line at output scale, and the four trunk zones are not visually well separated. Ringed proboscis and unspined posterior segment are present, but this still risks generic long annulated worm/long Ottoia rather than recognizable Louisella. Recommend revise posterior silhouette and improve paired row/zonal legibility; do not describe as simply “long Ottoia.” Miskoia is synonym, not a second species/count. Geometry has a modeled recessed aperture, but it is not visually legible, so do not credit visual terminal opening.

hoodoo.independent_visual_review: Inspected original concept, frozen brief and all eight final views/sheet. Correctly slender, irregular radial form with modest protective cap and faceted side outline, yet four similarly spaced full-rim ledges with aligned pale bands create an overly regular tier-stack rhythm even after refinement. Retained earlier overregular attempt is correctly kept rather than overwritten; current r001 is the refined two-run subject. Recommend make the cap-protected pillar more irregular and break repeated tier spacing; not a named-location/measurement claim.
